fichas.title: Camping — General Design Notes
fichas.summary: Guidance for camping sites and motorhome parks covers site access, separation and grouping of pitches, minimum pitch areas, fire-service access, tent and vehicle dimensions, and communal facilities. The page also illustrates tent types, caravans, motorhomes, and a campsite layout.
